scope: Unresolved native measurements. None of these gates was executed, passed or converted into a documentation check by this review.
policy: A gate becomes passed only from a separately admitted native protocol with sealed inputs, evidence and failure conditions. Documentation and arithmetic checks never satisfy a gate.

gates.name: response_learning_repair
gates.requirement: A new DC-P1 protocol must obtain useful post-teaching free-generation and fresh-instance output, not only lower NLL or teacher-forced fit.
gates.previous_evidence: P response diagnostic: NLL 10.6891 to 5.6083, teacher-forced exact 0/28, greedy train-fit 0/28

gates.name: vision_first_update_overshoot
gates.requirement: A bounded DC-V1 protocol must show loss and meaningful answer/caption progress without the first-step overshoot.
gates.previous_evidence: first update raised answer/caption NLL 10.7045/9.7734 to 11.7419/13.4482; answers 0/14

gates.name: native_episodic_retrieval_and_readout
gates.requirement: Learned native selection, compressed readout, abstention and complete-fact recall must pass on new role-sealed fixtures.
gates.previous_evidence: exact selected-record fixture 148/152 held-out with host selection and zero updates; learned-memory acceptance v4 rejected at 21/384 accepted-correct

gates.name: P_capacity_fit_and_learning
gates.requirement: P32 then P64 must improve learning or retention at fixed active work, or lower cost at matched quality, with measured residency inside a declared profile.
gates.previous_evidence: P16 continuation/restart matched exactly; no capacity result exists

gates.name: Mkv_sparse_execution
gates.requirement: A declared row-sparse optimizer must preserve inactive rows, preserve selected-row state across restart, aggregate duplicate indices, keep per-row clocks and measure actual allocation.

gates.name: teacher_competence_and_self_distillation
gates.requirement: The evidence-conditioned teacher must answer the task before distillation, with all teacher, rollout, replay and checking work measured at equal total cost.
gates.previous_evidence: no teacher-competence or distillation run exists
gates.owner: DC-N3 after a useful inner learner

gates.name: outer_loop_gradient_and_clocks
gates.requirement: First-order and functional short-unroll outer objectives must declare their omitted paths and beat matched controls; two clocks must beat one at equal total parameters and work.
gates.previous_evidence: no outer-loop or multi-clock run exists

gates.name: spark_full_training_qualification
gates.requirement: The actual v5.1 graph must be profiled for residency, throughput and precision, and pass Spark-native parity and learning gates before full training.
gates.previous_evidence: historical 4.4B/65.57 GiB estimate predates the encoder, P and Mkv changes; does not fit the 50 GiB driver guard

gates.name: official_fp8_and_native_fp8_execution
gates.requirement: Official FP8 storage and native FP8 execution must be qualified separately from official BF16 and the dequantized BF16-storage derivative.
gates.previous_evidence: native FP8 was refused on MPS and never executed; derivative_02 export/reload is not native FP8 execution

gates.name: personality_specification_and_evaluation
gates.requirement: Personality must be supplied as a separate specification and evaluated separately; it is not inferred from research or affect labels.
gates.previous_evidence: user-supplied description pending; neutral conditioning path preserved
